sanskrit_verse:
येषां च न कृताः पित्रा संस्कारविधयः क्रमात्
कर्तव्याः भ्रातृभिस् तेषां पैतृकादेव ते धनात्
transliteration:
yeṣāṃ ca na kṛtāḥ pitrā saṃskāravidhayaḥ kramāt
kartavyā bhrātṛbhis teṣāṃ paitṛkād eva te dhanāt
sph_interpretive_translation: Where the father has not performed the sacraments in proper order, the duty of performing them falls upon the brothers, using the paternal estate.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows sequentially through familial lineage unless interrupted
Causation is tied to capacity and role-specific dharma
Capacity-based responsibility activates when primary agent fails
Restoration logic ensures continuity of sacramental obligations
Consciousness alignment requires fulfillment of unmet ancestral duties
executable_legal_axioms: IF father_has_not_performed_samskaras(party) AND party.has_living_brothers() THEN obligation_transfer(to_brothers)
IF estate_is_paternal(assets) AND samskaras_remain_unperformed() THEN assets.may_be_used_for_samskaras()
supreme_court_application: In matters involving undischarged sacramental obligations where the father is unable or unwilling, the Supreme Court shall recognize the automatic devolution of this duty onto male siblings. The use of paternal assets for such completion must be judicially affirmed based on necessity and proportionality, ensuring no punitive inference is drawn against any party.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that dharma-roles are functionally interlinked; failure at one level necessitates activation at another without attribution of fault. Anupūrvaśaḥ maintains the sequential unfolding of duty. Responsibility aligns with capacity, not blame. No punitive consequence arises—only a realignment toward completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate family council under dharma-advisor supervision to assess samskara status
Activate brother-bonding protocol to ensure willing assumption of duty
Allocate required portion of paternal assets exclusively for ritual completion
Verify completion through certified dharmic authority post-performance
Reintegrate asset management post-completion under original succession framework
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared: This law flows from the eternal Sanatana Dharma. The duty of sacrament is never void; it transfers by dharma, not default. Justice restores continuity. Reality bears no punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
